div.head: Hu 2
div.ab: (Ðæt men faran on ryd æfter ðeofan.) Gyf neod on handa stande, cyðe hit man ðam hundredesmen, ⁊ he syððan ðam teoðingmannum; ⁊ faran ealle forð, ðær him God wisig[e], þæt hi tocuman moton; do ðam ðeofe his riht, swa hit ær Eadmundes cwide wæs.

Si necesse sit in manibus, indicetur hominibus hundredi, et ipsi postea indicent (denuntient) hominibus decimarum; et eant omnes pariter, quo Deus concedet (annuerit), ut inuenire possint; et faciant furi rectum suum, sicut prius Eadmundi regis fuit institutum.

Quodsi necessitas instet, primum nuncietur concionatori centenarii, qui deinde decimacionariis (id est singulis qui presunt decimacionibus); omnesque proficiscantur, quoadusque ducatu Dei perueniant quo cupiunt; furi quidem quod rectum est faciant, secundum quod ante ab Eadmundo rege institutum est.

Þæt men faran on cryd æfter ðeofan. Gyf neod on handa stande, cyðe hit man ðam hundredesmen, ⁊ he syððan ðam teoðingmannum; ⁊ faran ealle forð, ðær him God wisige, þæt hi tocuman moton; do ðam ðeofe his riht, swa hit ær Eadmundes cwide wæs.

That men go without delay in pursuit of thieves. If the need is urgent, the chief official of the hundred shall be informed, and shall forthwith inform the chief officials of the tithings, and all shall go forth, as God shall direct them, until they succeed in coming upon the thief. He shall receive his deserts as has already been decreed by Edmund.

(Dass die Männer hinter den Dieben im Zuge herjagen. B) Wenn dringende Noth vorhanden ist, künde man es dem Hundertvorsteher, und dieser dann den Zehntschaftvorstehern; und sie sollen alle hinausziehen, wohin ihnen Gott zeigt, dass sie zum [Ziel] kommen können; [man] vollziehe am Diebe dessen Rechts[strafe], wie es bisher (König Qu., Con.) Eadmunds Verordnung war.

(That the men pursue the thieves in a riding party. B) If there is urgent need, let it be announced to the hundred-man, and he then to the tithing-men; and they are all to go out wherever God shows them that they may reach [the goal]; [let] the thief's lawful [punishment] be carried out on him, as was previously (King, Qu., Con.) Edmund's ordinance.
div.note: B's rubric was added later in red (missing from both translators, so not in the archetype). B would need ‘mon’ (or ‘don’ as in II Cn 84.4) supplied before ‘ðam ðeofe’. Liebermann compares III Em 2.
